benefit_summary: Margin-money subsidy through a bank-linked loan for eligible new manufacturing units. Project-cost limits and contribution rules apply.
application_notes: Review the current eligibility criteria and project report requirements on the official PMEGP portal before applying.

benefit_summary: Margin-money subsidy through a bank-linked loan for eligible new service or business units. Project-cost limits and contribution rules apply.
application_notes: Review the current eligibility criteria and project report requirements on the official PMEGP portal before applying.

benefit_summary: Credit-guarantee support can help eligible MSME loans be considered without conventional collateral, subject to lender appraisal.
application_notes: A participating lender evaluates the proposal. Udyam registration and the lender's credit assessment remain important.

benefit_summary: Micro-enterprise loan category for a small funding need, generally up to ₹50,000.
application_notes: Speak with an eligible lender about the business need, identity documents, and any local documentation requirements.

benefit_summary: Micro-enterprise loan category for businesses needing roughly ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh.
application_notes: Prepare a practical use-of-funds note and supporting business records for the lender.

benefit_summary: Micro-enterprise loan category for growth funding of roughly ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh.
application_notes: The lending decision, repayment capacity, and current product terms are assessed by the lender.

benefit_summary: Bank-loan programme for eligible greenfield enterprises led by a woman or SC/ST entrepreneur, subject to lender assessment.
application_notes: Confirm borrower eligibility, greenfield status, and the current loan structure with an authorised lender or the official portal.

benefit_summary: Credit-guarantee support for eligible DPIIT-recognised startups through participating financial institutions.
application_notes: Check DPIIT recognition and the latest CGSS operational guidelines before approaching a participating lender.

benefit_summary: Quality and sustainability certification support for MSMEs pursuing ZED assessment and improvement.
application_notes: Verify the latest incentive structure and registration steps on the official ZED portal.

benefit_summary: State employment-generation support for eligible new micro enterprises in Maharashtra, subject to current guidelines.
application_notes: Check the official Maharashtra CMEGP portal for project categories, contribution, and current application windows.
